note: Hand-labelled relevance set for on-device search, run against the canary day. Each query names the CANARY it must retrieve, not an item id and not a rank: an id shifts when a canary is added, a rank shifts when a sibling changes, a canary name is stable. The test resolves the name to an item through that fixture's own title.

pass_bar.why: Four of five. A missed result costs a reader a convenience, so the bar is deliberately loose; the tight bars belong on the canaries, where a failure costs trust.
